title: How do I publish a survey?
intent: This article explains how a survey owner publishes a survey to make it available for respondents.
short_answer: To publish a survey, navigate to the survey's Overview page and click the 'Publish' button. Publishing creates a snapshot of the current draft as the live version. Once published, the survey URL becomes active and respondents can submit contributions. Only the survey owner can publish.
prerequisites: The user must be the survey owner
The survey must be in Draft or Unpublished state
The survey must have at least one element
All mandatory translations must be complete
If a validator is configured, the survey must be validated first
procedure: Open the survey in the management area
The system creates a published version of the survey
The survey becomes accessible at its public URL
If start/end dates are configured, the survey will auto-activate/deactivate accordingly
important_conditions: Publishing creates a copy of the draft survey as the published version
Subsequent edits to the draft create pending changes that must be explicitly applied
If the survey has translations, all active translations must be complete
A survey can be configured for automatic publishing with a start date
The first publication triggers a notification email if configured
After first publication, the firstPublished date is recorded permanently
troubleshooting: Publish button not visible: Only the survey owner can publish
Translation is not complete error: Complete all active translations or deactivate incomplete ones
Survey not accessible after publishing: Check if start/end dates are set
